description.value: Black Salt Cafe is a seasonal East Shore bistro in Crawford Bay on Hwy 3a, set along the eastern shore of Kootenay Lake. It focuses on local, organic, and sustainable ingredients across a menu of artisanal cocktails, tapas, entrees, and desserts. Cyclists can dine on a garden patio or inside a colourful gallery dining space.
